notes: Account background: global enterprise search provider for genomics and R&D docs. Heavy long-tail corpus (compressed PDF, legacy docs).
Primary ask: scale 100M-1B vectors, keep reranking/embedding cost below $0.003/query while meeting p99 latency <150ms for first-pass + rerank pipeline.
Index profile: expect 200M initial vectors (1536 dim), onboarding to 800M in 12 months; mix of dense embeddings + sparse metadata filters.
Architecture constraints: must run in customer VPC for IP protection; eventual on-prem air-gapped feasibility review (Q3).
Performance notes: want automatic KV/prefix caching for hot queries, request batching for throughput, and model quantization recommendations (8-bit / int4) to reduce GPU memory footprint.
Quote from CTO: "We can tolerate some added recall loss if per-query cost drops by 40% — but tail latency cannot exceed 200ms for 95% of queries."
Procurement: security + legal loop is longest; budget sign-off contingent on cost model that includes cache hit assumptions and dedicated pool sizing.
POC ask: show 500M-vector read throughput at simulated 2k–5k QPS with mixed queries (embedding similarity + 3-stage rerank).
Demo feedback: without auto-batching and prefix cache, p95 climbed above SLA; with tuning, p95 reduced to ~120ms in test harness (see drive deck).
Next AE notes: prioritize a POC run inside their VPC (private) with telemetry hooks and a small canary rollout for reranker models.
use_case_summary: Enterprise RAG/search provider evaluating Redwood Dedicated/Private for massive-scale embeddings + reranking. Needs predictable per-query economics for 200M–1B vectors, sub-150ms tail latency with KV cache and optimized batching, strong data residency and KMS integrations.
index_profile: Estimated 200M initial vectors, growth to 800M+ within 12 months; vector dim 1536; mix of dense embeddings and sparse metadata; ~40–60% queries cold, 20% hot tails expecting cache effectiveness improvements.
performance_targets: QPS target 2000-5000 (mixed reads), first-pass ANN p99 <120-150ms, full pipeline (1st pass + rerank) p99 <200ms, cost per end-to-end query target <$0.003
